title: Molten PvP
description: A 16x CPvP Texturepack Themed Around Fire
body: Molten has just been remastered! This legacy pack has been updated and made significantly better to suit all your needs in modern PvP with a blazing fire theme! **Molten currently retextures:** - Netherite Sword, Pickaxe and Armor - Endcrystals, Respawn Anchors and Glowstone - Totem of Undying, Golden apples, Enderpeals, EXP Bottles and Crossbow - Crit Particles and Invisible Explosion Particles - GUI and HUD, from my other Fire Themed Texturepack "Heatwave" - Potion Effects - Enchant Glint - Obsidian - Small Utilities
